title: Practice Photo Gallery
description: Your device storage is full! Let's make some space. Look at the photos below. Tap the ones that are blurry or mistakes, and tap 'Delete'. Don't worry—you cannot lose real photos here!

photos.description: Clear, smiling photo of a family at a birthday party.
photos.justInTimeHint: This looks like a clear, wonderful memory to keep.

photos.description: Completely blurry, unrecognizable smear of colors.
photos.justInTimeHint: This one might be a bit blurry or accidental. It's safe to clear out space!

photos.description: Dark, blurry photo of the inside of a pocket or a foot.
photos.justInTimeHint: This one might be a bit blurry or accidental. It's safe to clear out space!

photos.description: Clear picture of a pet dog sitting still.
photos.justInTimeHint: This looks like a clear, wonderful memory to keep.

photos.description: Picture of a garden flower (looks exactly like Photo 6).
photos.justInTimeHint: This one might be a bit blurry or accidental. It's safe to clear out space!

photos.description: Picture of the exact same garden flower, but slightly brighter and better framed.
photos.justInTimeHint: This looks like a clear, wonderful memory to keep.

gentleFailureKeeperDeleted.title: A Great Time to Learn About Undo!
gentleFailureKeeperDeleted.message: It is so natural to be cautious about deleting a clear photo! The wonderful news is that your device has a 'Recently Deleted' folder that keeps them safe for a whole month. You can always undo it! Try clicking the blue Undo button to practice bringing it back.

gentleFailureNotEnoughDeleted.title: Wonderful Caution!
gentleFailureNotEnoughDeleted.message: You are being very careful with your photos, which is a great instinct! To make enough room for new memories, try selecting the ones that are completely blurry or accidental pocket shots. It's safe to practice here!

success.title: Beautifully Done!
success.message: You made plenty of room for new memories while keeping the clear, precious ones. And you now know the 'Recently Deleted' folder is always there to support you. Fantastic job!
